svg.title: alabs
svg.desc: A map of alabs built by alabs from views/alabs/view.json. Each landmark carries data-landmark, data-note and data-path; paths are relative to the alabs root. Every arrow cites evidence in view.json.
svg.text: A local-first macOS workspace. Rust enforces the filesystem boundary, React and Monaco present the
files, and a local model is optional. Paths are relative to this repository.
What alabs is, what must stay true, and how the pieces connect.
Knowledge folders, creature definitions and the artwork.
Window, permissions, content security policy and the Rust entry point.
Everything that touches the disk, runs a program or opens a socket.
How the interface reaches Rust and what happens when alabs opens.
The surfaces a person works in.
Maps of a work folder: how they are checked, drawn and shown.
The two features that need Ollama; nothing else does.
What turns the source into an application.
